# HEM v0.8.4

Configured controller targets in Trends now stay level between sparse reports and step vertically at each recorded change. Both limits of a heat/cool range follow the same timeline. Moving the cursor between reports shows the last recorded target while missing measurements, PID demand or device output keep their own gaps.

HEM can record a configured target change while its selected room sensor is waiting for a fresh reading. The chart also connects compatible setpoints already recorded by earlier versions.

Room faces combine independent temperature, humidity and air-quality marks. Cold and humid rooms show a snowflake and a filled droplet together, with a mask when air quality is poor. The face uses the configured indoor humidity limit even when the room shows a mold tile in place of a humidity sensor tile.
